rules.title: Broker fee paid only by the party who hired the broker
rules.requirement: A licensed broker or salesperson may contract with either a prospective tenant or a landlord to find rental housing or a tenant. Any broker fee may be paid only by the party (lessor or tenant) who originally engaged and contracted with the broker.
rules.coverage_text: Fees of licensed real estate brokers or salespersons engaged in finding dwelling accommodations for prospective tenants.
rules.citation: General Law - Part I, Title XVI, Chapter 112, Section 87DDD 1/2, as amended by 2025, 9, Sec. 43
rules.quoted_span: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
